issue: New entry not persisted after page reload
actual: Creating entry "Zebra QA task" (Priority 7, Mar 9 2026, Completed checked) appeared immediately as a 6th row. After reloading http://localhost:6074/, the table showed only the 5 original seed rows and localStorage was empty (Object.keys(localStorage) === []).
evidence: Pre-reload rows: 6 incl. "Zebra QA task | 7 | Mar 9, 2026 | check". Post-reload rows: 5, no Zebra entry.

Fields dialog offers Text/Number/Date/Checkbox options. Added field "Reviewed" (Checkbox): new column appeared in table header, a "Reviewed" checkbox control appeared in Add Entry form, and a "Reviewed" row appeared on every card.

Saved entry "Alpha task" / 12 / 2026-02-28 / Completed unchecked / Reviewed checked. Table row: "Alpha task | 12 | Feb 28, 2026 | x-icon | check-icon". Card: Priority 12, Due Date Feb 28 2026, Completed No, Reviewed Yes.
Switched Table -> Cards: same 6 entries in same order with identical field values; footer count stayed "6 entries".
All 6 entries and all 5 fields render in both views with matching values; unset "Reviewed" values display as an em dash "—" in both table cells and card rows.
Entry form uses a role=checkbox toggle with adjacent "No"/"Yes" label; table shows green check icon (checked) vs muted x icon (unchecked); cards show icon + explicit "Yes"/"No" text.

Configure Fields dialog type dropdown lists labeled options Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Entry form renders input[type=text] for Task Name, input[type=number] for Priority, input[type=date] for Due Date, and a checkbox toggle for Completed/Reviewed.
Typing "abc" character-by-character into the Priority number input left value "0" (validity.valid=true, badInput=false); valid value 12 saved and displayed as 12.

Typing "02/31/2026" into Due Date left value "" with validity.badInput=true (invalid calendar date not accepted); programmatic set of "2026-02-31" also coerced to "". Valid date 2026-02-28 saved and displayed as "Feb 28, 2026".

Cards: Sort menu lists all 5 fields; Priority asc gave 1,1,2,2,3,12 and second click gave descending (status "Sorted by Priority (descending)"). Table: Task Name header click sorted A→Z then Z→A. Switching Cards→Table showed table's own state ("Drag entries to reorder" / then Task Name desc) while returning to Cards restored "Sorted by Priority (descending)" — sorts are independent per view.

Selecting a sort field reorders rows immediately without reload; active field/direction indicated by Sort button label, an arrow icon on the active column header, and footer text "Sorted by <Field> (ascending|descending)". App remained interactive (menus, view switch, add entry all still worked).

Before/after sorting by Task Name asc & desc and Priority asc & desc, the count stayed "6 entries" and each row kept identical values (e.g. "Alpha task|12|Feb 28, 2026|NO|YES", "Team sync meeting notes|2|Jan 14, 2026|YES|—"); only row order changed.

actual: The app exposes only Fields, Sort, Table/Cards, Add Entry and a single free-text "Search entries..." box. Column headers contain only sort buttons (no filter menu/icon), the Sort menu has no filter entries, and the only input in the whole page is the search box (document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea') returns just the search input). There is no way to define per-field criteria or to clear filters.

issue: Filtering not implemented, so criteria-based inclusion cannot be satisfied
actual: No filter criteria UI exists anywhere in the app (no filter controls in toolbar, column headers, Sort menu or Fields dialog), so entries cannot be filtered by criteria nor can filters be cleared.

issue: Quick search matches raw stored values, not the formatted values shown to users
actual: Searching "Feb 28" (the displayed Due Date text "Feb 28, 2026") returned "0 entries matching", while searching the raw value "2026-02-28" returned 1 entry (Alpha task). Searching "Yes" (the checkbox state shown in card view, and green check in table) returned "0 entries matching" although two entries display Completed = Yes.
evidence: Status line: '0 entries matching "Feb 28"' vs '1 entry matching "2026-02-28"'; '0 entries matching "Yes"'.
Query "REPORT" (uppercase) matched "Prepare quarterly report" case-insensitively and count updated to '1 entry matching "REPORT"'. Clearing the box restored all 6 rows with status "6 entries".

With sort cleared ("Drag entries to reorder"), keyboard drag (space + arrows) on the row handle moved "Design new landing page" from position 1 to 3 in the table (order: Review, Update, Design, Prepare, Team, Alpha). In Cards, the same entry was moved to position 2 (Review, Design, Update, ...). Switching Cards->Table->Cards preserved each view's distinct manual order.

actual: The app has no import control: toolbar offers only Fields, Sort, Table, Cards, Add Entry; the Configure Fields dialog contains only field rows, an Add-field row, a note and Close; document.querySelectorAll('input[type=file]').length === 0 and the only occurrence of the word "import" on the page is the static note "Configure fields before importing data." Therefore importing after defining a schema, and rejection of type-mismatched imported values, cannot be performed.
